headline: Priya can distinguish visibility, focus, event actions, and native syncing colors before installing the extension.
overview: A live product-level walk for Calendar Clarity, framed around Priya Shah's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
payoff: Priya can distinguish visibility, focus, event actions, and native syncing colors before installing the extension.

scenes.title: The same calendar, with less visual competition
scenes.narrative: Before and after states explain the product without asking Priya to abandon Google Calendar or create another account.
frameCaptions: The same calendar, with less visual competition

scenes.title: Four jobs are kept separate
scenes.narrative: Visibility, focus, event actions, and colors are presented as distinct tools so Priya can evaluate the part she actually needs.

scenes.title: Visibility dims noise without hiding events
scenes.narrative: Solo, external, declined, and tentative events recede but remain present, preserving awareness without equal visual weight.
frameCaptions: Visibility dims noise without hiding events

scenes.title: Focus happens inside the event context
scenes.narrative: The timer, ambient sounds, and Zen mode keep the work session attached to the calendar block that justified it.
frameCaptions: Focus happens inside the event context

scenes.title: Colors are native, named, and portable
scenes.narrative: AI grouping remains optional, while saved colors use Google's own event colors so they survive on mobile and other devices.
frameCaptions: Colors are native, named, and portable
